logical_reasoning.question: Five developers complete a project in 10 days. How many days will ten developers take?
logical_reasoning.answer: Ten developers will take 5 days because the number of developers is doubled.

scenario_evaluation.question: Your Python application produces an unexpected error. What would you do?
scenario_evaluation.answer: I would check the error message and identify the line where the error occurs. Then I would debug the code and search for a solution if needed.
